lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anadin jaladee phirai din raatee bin pir bahu dukh paavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, day and night, they burn. Without her Husband Lord, the soul-bride suffers in terrible pain. ||2||
Her body and her status shall not go with her to the world hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai chhutai sach kamaae ||
lines.translation: Where she is called to answer for her account, there, she shall be emancipated only by true actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan se dhanava(n)te aithai othai naam samaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Those who serve the True Guru shall prosper; here and hereafter, they are absorbed in the Naam. ||3||
She who adorns herself with the Love and the Fear of God,
by Guru's Grace, obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence as her home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa ravai din raatee majeethai ra(n)g banaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: Night and day, day and night, she constantly ravishes and enjoys her Beloved. She is dyed in the permanent color of His Love. ||4||
The Husband Lord abides with everyone, always;
but how rare are those few who, by Guru's Grace, obtain His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: meraa prabh at oocho oochaa kar kirapaa aap milaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: My God is the Highest of the High; granting His Grace, He merges us into Himself. ||5||
This world is asleep in emotional attachment to Maya.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it ultimately comes to ruin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jis te sutaa so jaagaae guramat sojhee paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: The One who put it to sleep shall also awaken it. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding dawns. ||6||
One who drinks in this Nectar, shall have his delusions dispelled.
By Guru's Grace, the state of liberation is attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee rataa sadaa bairaagee aap maar milaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: One who is imbued with devotion to the Lord, remains always balanced and detached. Subduing selfishness and conceit, he is united with the Lord. ||7||
He Himself creates, and He Himself assigns us to our tasks.
He Himself gives sustenance to the 8.4 million species of beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai sach raate jo tis bhaavai s kaar karaavaniaa ||8||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam are atuned to Truth. They do that which is pleasing to His Will. ||8||4||5||
Maajh, Third Mehl:
Diamonds and rubies are produced deep within the self.
They are assayed and valued through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin sach palai sach vakhaanahi sach kasavatee laavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have gathered Truth, speak Truth; they apply the Touch-stone of Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree gur kee baanee ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Word of the Guru's Bani within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan paaiaa jotee jot milaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the midst of the darkness of the world, they obtain the Immaculate One, and their light merges into the Light. ||1||Pause||
Within this body are countless vast vistas;
the Immaculate Naam is totally Inaccessible and Infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai soee paae aape bakhas milaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: He alone becomes Gurmukh and obtains it, whom the Lord forgives, and unites with Himself. ||2||
My Lord and Master implants the Truth.
By Guru's Grace, one's consciousness is attached to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach varatai sabhanee thaaee sache sach samaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; the true ones merge in Truth. ||3||
The True Carefree Lord is my Beloved.
He cuts out our sinful mistakes and evil actions;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: prem preet sadaa dhiaaeeai bhai bhaai bhagat driRaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: with love and affection, meditate forever on Him. He implants the Fear of God and loving devotional worship within us. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree bhagat sachee je sache bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Devotional worship is True, if it pleases the True Lord.
He Himself bestows it; He does not regret it later.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa eko daataa sabade maar jeevaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: He alone is the Giver of all beings. The Lord kills with the Word of His Shabad, and then revives. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tudh baajhahu mai koee naahee ||
lines.translation: Other than You, Lord, nothing is mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tudhai sevee tai tudh saalaahee ||
lines.translation: I serve You, Lord, and I praise You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel laihu prabh saache poorai karam too(n) paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: You unite me with Yourself, O True God. Through perfect good karma You are obtained. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai hor na koee tudhai jehaa ||
lines.translation: For me, there is no other like You.
By Your Glance of Grace, my body is blessed and sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin saar samaal har raakhahi guramukh sahaj samaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, the Lord takes care of us and protects us. The Gurmukhs are absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad mai hor na koee ||
lines.translation: For me, there is no other as Great as You.
You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy.
